write_objective.description: Healthy time for a new object to appear at the destination, for example `15m`.

write_timeout.title: Write visibility timeout
write_timeout.description: Hard limit for a new object to appear at the destination, for example `30m`.

delete_timeout.title: Delete visibility timeout

autodetection_retry.description: Seconds between retries of the initial bucket check. Zero disables retries.

mode.ui:help:
Pick the mode that matches what you want to verify.

- `lifecycle`: one endpoint. Writes a small probe object, reads it back, confirms it is listed, deletes it, and confirms it is gone. Bucket versioning must never have been enabled.
- `ceph_multisite`: one replication direction between two Ceph RGW zones. Writes at the source, waits until the object appears at the destination, deletes it at the source, and waits until the destination no longer serves it. Both buckets must be unversioned.
- `aws_replication`: one replication direction between two versioned AWS S3 buckets. Tracks the exact object versions and delete markers that AWS replication creates and requires an enabled replication rule with delete marker replication.

Replication modes check one direction; add a second job with source and destination swapped for the reverse direction. All modes create and delete objects only under the configured prefix, in a namespace private to this Agent and job. Configure only the section of the selected mode.

mode_lifecycle.ui:help: Each collection writes one 4 KiB probe object under the prefix, reads it back and verifies its content, confirms it is listed, deletes it, and confirms it is gone. The bucket must never have had versioning enabled (a suspended state is rejected). Permissions on the bucket: `s3:GetBucketVersioning`, `s3:PutObject`, `s3:GetObject`, `s3:ListBucket`, `s3:DeleteObject`.

endpoint.ui:help: For Ceph RGW or other S3-compatible services set the full URL, for example `https://rgw.example.net:8443`. For AWS S3 leave it empty and set the region.

credentials.ui:help: Leave empty to let the AWS SDK find credentials on the Agent host: environment variables, shared config and profiles, instance or task roles. Fill in both keys to use static credentials, preferably as go.d secret references such as `${env:NAME}`.

assume_role.ui:help: Optional second step: the base credentials call STS AssumeRole and the collector uses the returned temporary credentials for this endpoint only. The STS request uses this endpoint's region, timeout, proxy, and TLS settings.

proxy_url.ui:help: Used for both S3 and STS AssumeRole traffic of this endpoint. Leave empty to honor the `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, and `NO_PROXY` environment of the Agent. Treated as a secret because proxy URLs may embed credentials.

name.ui:help: Shown as the `source` chart label. Changing it does not affect the objects the collector owns.

region.ui:help: Required even for services that do not use regions; Ceph RGW deployments commonly use `us-east-1`.

path_style.ui:help: Keep enabled for Ceph RGW and most S3-compatible services. Disable for AWS S3, which uses virtual-hosted-style addressing.

timeout.ui:help: Applies to each S3 request and to the STS AssumeRole request of this endpoint, including connection setup and TLS handshake. A request that exceeds it is a failed operation with reason `request`.

tls_skip_verify.ui:help: Insecure. Prefer installing the service's CA or setting the TLS CA bundle.

bucket.ui:help: The collector writes, reads, lists, and deletes its probe objects here. Versioning must never have been enabled.

prefix.ui:help: The collector only writes, reads, lists, and deletes keys under `<prefix><owner>/`, where the owner segment is derived from this Agent and job. Reserve the prefix for Netdata; several Agents and jobs may share it.

mode_ceph_multisite.ui:help: Writes a probe object at the source zone, polls the destination once per collection until the same key is readable there with the same content, deletes it at the source, and polls until the destination no longer serves it. Both buckets must be unversioned. Source permissions: `s3:GetBucketVersioning`, `s3:PutObject`, `s3:GetObject`, `s3:DeleteObject`. Destination permissions: `s3:GetBucketVersioning`, `s3:GetObject`, `s3:DeleteObject` (cleanup of replicated copies only; the collector never writes there).

bucket.ui:help: Replicated copies are read from here. The collector never writes to this bucket and deletes only its own replicated copies during cleanup. Versioning must never have been enabled.

prefix.ui:help: The collector only writes, reads, lists, and deletes keys under `<prefix><owner>/`, where the owner segment is derived from this Agent and job. Reserve the prefix for Netdata; several Agents and jobs may share it.

write_objective.ui:help: Measured from the successful source write until the destination serves the object with the correct content. Exceeding it marks the write objective chart as breached; the probe keeps waiting until the write timeout. Must be at least the collection interval and at most `24h`.

write_timeout.ui:help: When exceeded the probe fails with reason `visibility_timeout` and the object is scheduled for cleanup. Must be between the write objective and `24h`.

delete_objective.ui:help: Measured from the successful source delete until the destination no longer serves the object. Exceeding it marks the delete objective chart as breached; the probe keeps waiting until the delete timeout. Must be at least the collection interval and at most `24h`.

delete_timeout.ui:help: When exceeded the probe fails with reason `delete_timeout` and cleanup is scheduled. Must be between the delete objective and `24h`.

mode_aws_replication.ui:help: Follows AWS S3 replication semantics: the source write creates an object version and the source delete creates a delete marker, and both are expected to replicate. Both buckets need versioning enabled with MFA Delete off. The source bucket needs an enabled replication rule that covers the prefix without tag filters, targets the destination bucket, and replicates delete markers; no other enabled rule may replicate the prefix to a different bucket. Source permissions: `s3:GetBucketVersioning`, `s3:GetReplicationConfiguration`, `s3:PutObject`, `s3:GetObject`, `s3:GetObjectVersion`, `s3:ListBucketVersions`, `s3:DeleteObject`, `s3:DeleteObjectVersion`. Destination permissions: `s3:GetBucketVersioning`, `s3:GetObject`, `s3:ListBucketVersions`, `s3:DeleteObjectVersion`.
